projects.intervention_detail: Probiotic group: Probio-M8 powder (2g sachet, 3x10^10 CFU/day) + atorvastatin 20mg/day + metoprolol; Placebo group: placebo material + atorvastatin + metoprolol; 6-month intervention

papers.title: Bifidobacterium lactis Probio-M8 Adjuvant Treatment Confers Added Benefits to Patients with Coronary Artery Disease via Target Modulation of the Gut-Heart/-Brain Axes.

projects.title: Genome level reveals that probiotics supplementation can alleviate the clinical symptoms of patients with coronary heart disease
